faq: Do I need to supply the text and photos?
Yes, the main message and your own photos. If you have none, we can use simple graphic layouts or licensed stock images, and we tell you where each image comes from.
Which tool are the editable files in?
Canva is the default because most teams already use it. We can supply other formats on request, and we tell you before starting if your choice would change the price.
Can you copy a design I saw from another brand?
No. We take inspiration from your brand and your references, but we do not copy another brand's artwork, logos or photos.
Do you publish the posts for me?
Not in this service. We deliver the files. If you want us to schedule them, order the posting schedule service together with this one.

desc:
Social media post design turns your message into branded images, carousels and story graphics that stop the scroll and stay readable on a phone. Ecom Swift LLC designs them in your own brand and delivers files sized for each channel.

## Why post design shapes first impressions

A person scrolling a feed gives each post a fraction of a second. In that moment the image does most of the talking, long before anyone reads the caption. A cluttered graphic with tiny text, mismatched fonts or a stretched logo suggests a careless business. A tidy, consistent graphic suggests a reliable one.

Design also affects what people do with a post. A clear carousel is easy to swipe and save. A readable quote or offer graphic is easy to share. An image that does not fit the frame gets cropped, and the key message is lost.

## What is social media post design?

Social media post design is the creation of graphics made for social channels: single images, multi-slide carousels, story frames and cover images. Each is built at the right size for its channel, uses your brand colors, fonts and logo, and keeps text short enough to read on a small screen.

## How good graphics affect engagement and sales

Strong design helps in three ways. It makes your page recognizable, so followers know your posts at a glance. It makes information easier to take in, which is useful for offers, how-to steps and product details. It also gives your products a clean, professional frame that builds confidence before a customer visits your store.

Design alone does not sell. The product, price, timing and caption all matter, and we cannot promise a particular number of likes or orders. What good design can do is stop your message from being lost because of how it looks.

## What well-designed posts include

- Your logo, colors and fonts applied the same way every time.
- Text large enough to read on a phone without zooming.
- Safe margins, so nothing is cut off by platform interface elements.
- Sizes matched to feed, story and carousel formats.
- A clear focal point, such as the product or the main line of text.
- Carousel slides with a strong cover, steady flow and closing call to action.
- Space left for your caption to carry the detail.
- Consistent photo treatment, using your own product images.
- Cover images for highlights or pinned posts, in higher packages.
- Editable source files, so your team can reuse the layouts.

## What we do

You send your logo, colors, product photos and the message for each post. We choose a layout system that suits your brand, design the set and send it for your feedback. After approved changes, we deliver final image files and, depending on the package, editable files.

The Basic package covers a small set of single image posts for one channel. The Standard package adds carousels, story sizes and a reusable layout set. The Premium package delivers a larger monthly set with more carousels, cover images and a template pack for your team, plus a handover call. You can add an animated post or a brand template in Canva. We do not publish the posts unless you separately arrange it.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send the highest quality photos you have.
- Keep one idea per post.
- Write short headlines and put detail in the caption.
- Check each design on a phone before posting.
- Reuse the same layouts to stay consistent.

**Avoid:**
- Using photos taken from other websites without permission.
- Packing a slide with paragraphs of text.
- Switching fonts and colors from post to post.
- Placing key words near the edges of the frame.
- Asking us to copy another brand's design directly.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner who designs in a hurry and wants a cleaner, steadier look. It suits a brand with a new product line that needs a launch set of posts. It also suits a team with no designer that wants templates it can edit.

## What we need from you

Please send your logo files, brand colors and fonts if you have them, product photos, and the text or main message for each post. Tell us which channels you use so we get the sizes right. If you do not have brand rules, share a few examples you like and we will work from those. Everything is shared through files or links, so we never need passwords. If you want us to see how current posts perform, a viewer or analyst role is enough.
